name: Virag Packaging Library
principles: Use only the current packaging brief, current composer text and current uploads.
Design the package, label or form-factor itself; do not turn the task into a social post or flyer unless explicitly requested.
Preserve any explicitly locked package silhouette, dimensions, cap/lid, structure, logo and mandatory visible facts.
Use print-aware hierarchy, safe margins, curvature/seam awareness, material/finish logic and shelf readability.
Never invent ingredients, nutrition, certifications, legal/regulatory copy, net weight, claims or compliance marks.
If the user asks only for a label redesign, do not silently change the container form.

commands.label: Packaging Design
commands.desc: Complete packaging design for the current product.
commands.instruction: Design the actual packaging for the current product using supplied brand/product facts only. Build a professional front-facing hierarchy, material/finish direction and shelf-ready visual system while preserving any locked form factor.

commands.label: Label Design
commands.desc: Redesign the product label without changing container form.
commands.instruction: Design or redesign the current product label only. Preserve the container geometry unless explicitly asked otherwise. Build clear brand/product hierarchy, print-aware spacing and realistic curvature/seam behavior.

commands.label: Jar Packaging
commands.instruction: Create a jar/tub packaging design for the current product with realistic wrap geometry, front-panel hierarchy, cap/lid coordination and shelf readability. Do not alter supplied jar proportions unless explicitly requested.

commands.label: Bottle Packaging
commands.instruction: Create a bottle packaging design using the current product facts and brand cues. Account for bottle curvature, label panel visibility, cap relationship and practical front/back hierarchy without inventing regulatory content.

commands.label: Pouch Packaging
commands.instruction: Create a flexible pouch packaging design with realistic seals, gusset logic, safe print zones and strong shelf hierarchy. Preserve supplied product facts and avoid unsupported claims.

commands.label: Box Packaging
commands.instruction: Create a box packaging design with coherent front/side/back panel logic, brand hierarchy, print-safe spacing and realistic material/finish direction. Do not invent mandatory product information.

commands.label: Tube Packaging
commands.instruction: Create a tube packaging design with realistic cylindrical/flattened print behavior, cap relationship and front-panel readability. Preserve current product/brand facts exactly.

commands.label: Can Packaging
commands.instruction: Create a can packaging design with strong front read, realistic wrap continuity, top/bottom relationship and material finish. Use only supplied factual copy.

commands.label: Wrapper Design
commands.desc: Wrapper/sleeve packaging for bars, food or compact products.
commands.instruction: Create a wrapper or sleeve packaging design with realistic folds/seams, strong front hierarchy and brand-fit materials. Preserve product facts and do not invent ingredients or claims.

commands.label: Packaging Refresh
commands.desc: Modernize existing packaging while preserving recognition.
commands.instruction: Refresh the current existing package design without losing brand/product recognition. Improve hierarchy, typography, spacing, materials and shelf impact while preserving supplied facts, logo and locked structural elements.
